name: yuanbao_proto_encode_head
notes: Yuanbao protobuf ConnMsg.Head encoder (src/plugins/platforms/yuanbao/yuanbao_proto_helpers.c::yb_encode_head vs LIVE gateway/platforms/yuanbao_proto.py::_encode_head). One branch rung per field presence (fields 1,2,3,4,5,6,10); V is the hex-encoded wire bytes from each side's own encoder, so varint/tag divergence fails. Inputs are tab-separated field tuples; status masked to 32 bits on both sides.
relabel_note: py_module does not exist in the Python payload (verified by filesystem check and by the runner raising FileNotFoundError). The feature was removed or moved out of the package, so there is no Python left to match: this gate cannot pass and must not be counted as ported.
